# UnicodeKruti — llms.txt
# https://unicodekruti.com/
# Last updated: 2026-09-10

## About

UnicodeKruti is a free browser-based Hindi font 
conversion platform. It converts text between 
Unicode Devanagari (Mangal, Nirmala UI, Kokila, 
Arial Unicode) and KrutiDev legacy encoding 
(KrutiDev 010, KrutiDev 10, Updesh) used by 
Indian government offices, CPCT and UPSSSC exam 
candidates, and DTP professionals.

All conversion runs entirely in the browser. 
No text is uploaded to any server. No signup 
or installation required.

Verified by: Akshay Verma, Software Developer 
and Hindi Typing Expert.
Accuracy: 99.9% on standard KrutiDev 010 
documents, validated against 40 CPCT practice 
papers and UP district court records.

## Primary Use Cases

- Unicode to KrutiDev 010 conversion for 
  CPCT, UPSSSC, UP Lekhpal, Patwari exams
- KrutiDev to Unicode conversion for NIC 
  portals, Gmail, WhatsApp
- Updesh font conversion for UP government 
  offices and district courts
- KrutiDev font download for Windows and Mac
- Nirmala UI, Mangal, Kokila to KrutiDev 
  conversion

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- Tool name: Unicode to KrutiDev Converter
- URL: https://unicodekruti.com/
- Price: Free, no account required
- Processing: Browser-only (JavaScript)
- Accuracy: 99.9% on KrutiDev 010 standard
- Supported input fonts: Mangal, Nirmala UI, 
  Kokila, Arial Unicode, Gargi, Aparajita, 
  Google Input Tools, InScript
- Output encoding: KrutiDev 010, KrutiDev 10, 
  Updesh
- Government exams supported: CPCT (MP), 
  UPSSSC (UP), UP Lekhpal, Rajasthan Patwari, 
  RSMSSB, BPSC (Bihar)
